hypothesis: Late optimization instability and endpoint sensitivity under constant-LR Adam
supporting_evidence: Inverse last Adam step reproduces last logged losses across 50 runs; seed1 VARA L2 doubles in final step; seed8/3/5 worsen; Vanilla4 L2 triples.
contradictory_evidence: VARA18 improves in its final step and was already poor; no earlier dense-error history establishes instability onset.
tests_performed: Offline inverse Adam; reconstructed deterministic final batches; independent final checkpoint inference; raw tail losses
result: Verified endpoint sensitivity and late loss spikes; originating cause unresolved
causal_confidence: High for the measured last-step effect; moderate for whole-run failure mechanism
classification: Numerical/optimization issue, shared by both methods; not a demonstrated implementation bug
minimum_correction: Report final-state sensitivity and retain frozen final metrics; diagnose one control before tuning
manuscript_implication: Large wins/losses cannot all be described as robust controller efficacy

hypothesis: 25-step acceptance does not protect the following 475 optimization steps
supporting_evidence: Trainer keeps probe-selected state and fixed batch for remaining475; all45 accepted guards within tolerance; sparse loss grows sharply after last guarded point.
contradictory_evidence: No intermediate dense checkpoints; cannot prove a particular accepted action caused later divergence; guard does reject actual short-horizon harm.
tests_performed: Source trace; all decisions audited; priority-seed retained-loss chronology
result: Verified design limitation; seed-specific causal responsibility not proven
causal_confidence: High for missing long-horizon guarantee; moderate for explaining failures
minimum_correction: Qualify guard claims as short-horizon monitored-objective protection; add endpoint diagnostics in a declared new experiment
manuscript_implication: Do not claim guard guarantees stable final reconstruction

hypothesis: Controller-off VARA is a different sampling trajectory from Vanilla
supporting_evidence: Uniform VARA717global+1331regional+shuffle differs from direct2048 uniform; AD4/7/16 have zero accepted actions; AD4 gains79.99%; AC2 gains44.43% without actions.
contradictory_evidence: Uniform marginal law, budgets and warmup match; not yet a demonstrated cause of AD catastrophic seeds.
tests_performed: Neutral sampler RNG/coordinate test; rejected CPU probe restores neutral Adam/model/RNG bit-exactly; no-action history audit
result: Verified mechanism-attribution confound, not a distribution or step-budget mismatch
causal_confidence: High for attribution confound; low for severe failures without proposed new control
classification: Protocol/implementation semantics; no violation of explicit existing sampling specification established
minimum_correction: One seed8 uniform-state forced-rejection VARA control; preserve existing runs
manuscript_implication: Attribute outcomes to the complete algorithm, not accepted interventions alone

hypothesis: Patch-percentile aggregate guards can miss individual-channel/global reconstruction damage
supporting_evidence: IC/sparse lack individual guards; patch90th percentile and mean with empty-patch zeros; synthetic20% IC/sparse damage accepted; single extreme outlier invisible to percentile.
contradictory_evidence: Dense error is intentionally evaluation-only; 41 actual AD positive-target probes were rejected by guard; absent absolute probe-channel metrics prevent checking actual IC/sparse damage.
tests_performed: Guard algebra counterexamples; percentile tail test; initial-time occupancy test; all decision thresholds audited
result: Verified information limitation; actual seed-level causal pathway remains plausible
causal_confidence: High for algebraic limitation; low/moderate for a particular failure
classification: Controller objective/information mismatch, not PDE defect
minimum_correction: Disclose protected proxies and missing evidence; any new guard is a separately declared protocol
manuscript_implication: Training Pareto protection does not imply held-out reconstruction Pareto improvement
